name: CONCRETE RETAINING WALL
text: A massive concrete wall stretches across the
upper level, scarred by rust stains and
cracks. It holds back the earth, separating
the lower ruins from whatever lies above.

name: POWER CABLES AND DOORWAY
text: Sagging cables connect an old pylon to a dimly
lit doorway cut into the concrete wall. A
small sign above the entrance promises
salvage, illuminated by a solitary lantern.

name: RUSTED DUMP TRUCK
text: The oxidized remains of a heavy hauler sit
half-buried in the dirt, its bed overflowing
with debris. Tough, leafy plants have begun to
claim the rusted cab and chassis.

name: BROKEN ASPHALT ROAD
text: Chunks of a dilapidated paved road are
scattered across the dusty ground, separated
by wide stretches of dirt. The grey asphalt is
fractured and worn away at the edges.

name: EXPOSED PIPING NETWORK
text: A network of rusted pipes runs along the upper
concrete wall, turning corners and dropping
down towards the ground. They are stained and
weathered from years of exposure.

name: UPPER WALL PIPING
text: Sections of old industrial piping cling to the
concrete wall, casting long shadows. The metal
shows heavy signs of oxidation and wear.

name: LOWER TRANSMISSION PYLON
text: A rusted metal transmission tower stands watch
near the broken road, its cables long gone.
The lattice structure is still intact despite
the pervasive decay.

name: MODULAR METAL STRUCTURE
text: A blocky, pre-fabricated metal unit sits in
the lower corner, attached to small piping. It
looks like a piece of modular machinery left
behind from the old settlement.

name: DISCARDED VEHICLE HULL
text: The crushed and rusted shell of a small
vehicle rests near the bottom edge of the
area. It's partially obscured by hardy shrubs
growing out of the dry soil.

name: PILE OF ROCKS
text: A cluster of jagged, grey rocks is gathered in
the corner, offering a bit of rough cover.
They are mostly barren, save for a few small
green sprouts at their base.

name: BOULDER CLUSTER
text: A group of large, smooth boulders rests
against the retaining wall on the upper right.
They are shaded by a small, broad-leafed tree
growing nearby.

name: HORIZONTAL PIPELINE SEGMENT
text: A straight run of rusted pipe spans across the
top right section of the concrete wall. The
metal is heavily corroded, showing years of
neglect.

name: SCATTERED GREY ROCKS
text: A few loose, grey rocks are strewn across the
dirt near the lower edge of the path. They
look like they tumbled down from a larger pile
over time.

name: ROCK AND DIRT PILE
text: A small mound of rocks and dirt sits near the
edge of the broken asphalt, partially covered
in dust. It seems like a natural accumulation
of debris in this arid landscape.
